title: Houseplant Soil Moisture Sensor
summary: Soil moisture sensor staked in the pot, OLED reading, battery powered

requirements.text: measure soil moisture with the capacitive probe
show moisture level and water/dry hint on the OLED
a button wakes it and takes a reading
runs on a LiPo charged from USB-C, deep sleep between readings

uses: in a potted houseplant at home, staked into the soil: glance at the display to see if watering is needed
on a windowsill with several pots: moved from pot to pot, one press wakes it and shows the moisture level
left alone for days on its battery: sleeps between readings, charged over USB-C

options.name: Soil stake
options.look: a small soft block on a spike in the pot, display facing up-out
options.panel: 0.96in OLED centred on the lid, page button beside it, probe cable exits the bottom into the soil

options.name: Pot clip
options.look: a small clip block hooked over the pot rim, probe lead drops into the soil
options.panel: OLED in the centre of the lid, button under it, probe cable exits the side

options.name: Desk puck
options.look: a round puck next to the pot with a wired probe in the soil
options.panel: OLED in the centre, button beside it, probe cable exits the back

concept.why: It lives where it measures, needs no extra stand, and the display faces the person while the probe stays in the soil.

firmware.notes: XIAO ESP32-C3, libraries Adafruit GFX + Adafruit SSD1306, flash via Arduino IDE

check.tool: g++ 14.2.0 compile, no link (arduino-esp32 3.x stubs, Seeed
